capture_contract.allowed_data: opaque ids, timestamps, bounded state enums, and digests only
capture_contract.forbidden_data: prompts, messages, transcripts, source content, diffs, paths, secrets, and credentials

reconciliation.missed_event_behavior: append a content-free best-effort failure marker when the private root is available; rebuild current state from local refs worktrees ledgers and explicit task metadata; mark activity coverage partial
reconciliation.ledger_index: exact-content SHA-256-bound rebuildable command/offset index; full JSON Schema on append; payload-parity integrity validation on cold replay; serialized stale recovery and owner-token release

activation_gate.performance_evidence: self-consistent local harness receipt bound to the exact runtime-adapter interface digest; not origin-authenticated and requires supervisor attestation

authority_boundary: This repo-local supervised shadow configuration is silent, content-free, non-blocking, and subject to Codex hook trust. It cannot enable prompts, notifications, schedulers, models, network calls, Git or task mutation, branch or worktree cleanup, archival, or later activation stages.
